Binding kinetics and potency

How tightly, how fast and how much: kinetics, affinity, drug concentration in study samples and cell-based potency.

Assays
3
Standard turnaround
6–14 days
Fastest priority slot
4 days

Binding data is only as good as the assay format behind it. Before running your samples we confirm surface activity, check for avidity effects and agree the fitting model, so the numbers you get back mean what they appear to mean.

For preclinical studies we develop and qualify ligand-binding assays for drug concentration in serum or plasma, then run study samples in batches as they arrive.

Questions this answers

  • What are the on-rate, off-rate and affinity for the target?
  • Do lead candidates compete for the same epitope?
  • What is drug concentration over time in study animals?
  • Is potency consistent between lots?
